mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour Price Volume Trend crossover of its fixed twenty-period exponential signal identifies a reversal in cumulative volume-weighted percentage-price pressure; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when PVT crosses strictly above its EMA(20); short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: PVT weights each completed bar's base volume by the full close-to-close percentage change before accumulation. Unlike OBV it preserves return magnitude rather than only its sign; it is not close-location weighting, rolling money flow, raw price momentum, prior candidate repair, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse cumulative volume-times-return path reversals are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including base volume
features.volume_return_contribution: completed base volume times (current completed close/previous completed close-1), finite; zero on equality
features.pvt: causal cumulative volume_return_contribution, reset across source gaps
features.signal: causal EMA(20) of PVT with alpha=2/21, emitted after full warmup
features.event: current finite nonzero PVT-signal sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical PVT with preregistered EMA(20) signal crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no signal period, PVT formula, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: canonical Price Volume Trend / Volume Price Trend convention
external_basis.selection_use: published PVT increment and one preregistered twenty-period signal only; no incidence or outcomes
